purpose: Authorized web application assessment (passive + controlled active)
scope: The authorized target only. The spider is bounded by spider.maxDepth.

modes.baseline: ZAP baseline scan: passive rules plus a small, curated set of low-impact active rules.
modes.passive: Adds spider.active=false so only passive crawling and passive rules run.

severity_mapping: riskcode 3=High, 2=Medium, 1=Low, 0=Informational. ZAP has no CRITICAL level and the lab never manufactures one.
prerequisites: A Java runtime is required. Docker image ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable bundles its own JRE.
notes: Alerts are indicators requiring manual verification; ZAP does not prove exploitability.

install.windows: winget install zaproxy.zaproxy.stable  (or start Docker Desktop and use the ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable image)
install.linux: Download from https://www.zaproxy.org/download/ or use the Docker image
install.generic: ZAP ships zap-baseline.py inside its installation directory; add that directory to PATH.
